Market today:
The market's feeling the heat, especially in your tech/chip heavy book. Geopolitical tensions are pushing oil up, but the real driver for you is the massive selloff in chip stocks, which shed over $1 trillion. This directly impacts your core holdings.

Your holdings:
SOXL is down a brutal -56.96% and is a leveraged ETF, meaning it decays and amplifies drops – especially painful on margin. SMH is also down -16.78% and flagged SELL. SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is already down -54.75% and moves fast; remember margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a very close eye on your stops for QQQ and SMH, as they are flagged SELL and close to their stops. Also, watch for any further news on chip sector performance.

Bottom line:
Protect your capital by respecting stops, especially on leveraged positions, given the current chip sector weakness and your margin exposure.
plays: Your SMH is at 529.6, below its 540 stop and flagged SELL. Consider trimming or exiting SMH to respect your stop and manage chip exposure.
This leveraged chip ETF, SOXL, is down -56.96% and well below its default stop. Given the chip selloff, consider a significant trim or exit to reduce extreme risk.
With chip stocks selling off, consider a speculative long entry on SOXS (inverse chip ETF) at 61.49-61.07 with a stop at 60.33.
